source: UST FDE1000 Evaluation Rubric.xlsx + PROVE Framework

blend.note: Applied uniformly across all 9 modules. Final blended score = (module_score * 0.6) + (vector_score * 0.4), each already 0-100.

cutoffs.note: Applied to the FINAL BLENDED score. Exemption additionally requires no single module rubric dimension AND no single VECTOR dimension scores below the floor.

consistency_rule.action_on_disagreement: auto-flag Borderline, route to human/SME review, do not average
consistency_rule.source: xlsx Scoring Guide sheet calibration rule; mirrors PROVE two-assessor rule

modules.name: FDE Mindset & Problem Framing
modules.mandatory_note: Carried over from PROVE framework: identity-shift module, not tested in the abstract. Confirm if this should change now that scoring is evidence-based.

skill_indices.name: AI vs Non-AI Framing
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Submitted use-case brief clearly distinguishes AI-solvable problems from rule-based / deterministic ones, with an explicit reason for why AI is (or is not) the right approach.

skill_indices.name: Responsible AI Awareness
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Work product identifies bias, fairness, or governance risks relevant to the specific use case and proposes a mitigation - not a generic disclaimer.

skill_indices.name: Prompt Engineering Discipline
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Submitted prompt library shows structured prompts (instruction, context, constraints) that are reusable and were tested against edge cases or hallucination risk.

skill_indices.name: Stakeholder Discovery
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Discovery notes or interview records show structured stakeholder identification and hypothesis-driven questioning, not just a captured feature wish-list.

skill_indices.name: Requirement Translation
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Functional and non-functional requirements are explicitly separated and traced back to a business problem statement in the submitted brief.

skill_indices.name: Use-Case Prioritization
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: A value-vs-complexity or ROI-based prioritization artefact is submitted, with a visible scoring method rather than a gut-feel ranking.

skill_indices.name: Architecture Decision Framework
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Submitted design includes a documented RAG vs fine-tuning vs agents vs ML decision, with trade-offs (cost, latency, data dependency) explicitly compared.

skill_indices.name: Enterprise Architecture Design
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Architecture diagram shows data flow, control flow, integration points and failure-handling strategy - reviewable by a peer without a verbal walkthrough.

skill_indices.name: Security & Governance
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Design artefact identifies PII / data-sensitivity handling, access control approach, and compliance considerations relevant to the use case.

skill_indices.name: Data Pipeline Build
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Submitted ingestion pipeline demonstrates working chunking, metadata handling and preprocessing logic on real or representative data.

skill_indices.name: RAG Retrieval Quality
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Retrieval strategy (top-k, hybrid search, reranking) is implemented, with before/after evidence of a tuning or optimization pass.

skill_indices.name: Hallucination Mitigation
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Submitted evaluation shows the candidate measured and reduced hallucination / incorrect-retrieval instances using a documented technique.

skill_indices.name: Agent Design
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: A working multi-step agent is submitted showing task decomposition, tool usage and error recovery - not a single-shot prompt relabelled as an 'agent'.

skill_indices.name: Framework Application
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Submitted code shows correct use of an orchestration framework (e.g. LangChain / LangGraph) for state, memory and transitions.

skill_indices.name: Multi-Agent Coordination
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Where applicable, submitted workflow demonstrates role-based agents with a defined communication or hand-off protocol.

skill_indices.name: API & Service Integration
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Submitted work shows the AI capability exposed as a service (REST/API) that integrates cleanly with an existing or mock backend system.

skill_indices.name: CI/CD & Environment Management
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Deployment artefact (pipeline config, container setup, or documented deployment steps) shows a repeatable, versioned deployment process.

skill_indices.name: Performance & Scaling
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Submitted analysis shows latency / throughput measurement and at least one concrete optimization (caching, batching, scaling) applied.

skill_indices.name: Monitoring & Logging
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Submitted dashboard or logs show key metrics tracked (latency, error rate, usage) with alerting or threshold logic defined.

skill_indices.name: Evaluation Framework
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Candidate has defined and applied success metrics through an evaluation pipeline (offline or online), not ad-hoc spot checks.

skill_indices.name: Troubleshooting Evidence
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Work product includes at least one documented root-cause diagnosis and fix for a pipeline or system failure.

skill_indices.name: Solution Narrative
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Submitted presentation / pitch structures the solution as a business narrative (problem -> approach -> outcome), not a feature list.

skill_indices.name: ROI / Business Case
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: A cost-benefit or ROI model is submitted with clearly stated assumptions, not just a headline savings figure.

skill_indices.name: Objection Handling
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Recording or notes from a client-facing session (real or role-play) show the candidate handling pushback with evidence-based responses.

modules.name: Capstone / End-to-End Delivery
modules.mandatory_note: Not exemptible - terminal by design, per PROVE framework. Everyone clears this regardless of exemptions earned elsewhere.
modules.vector_blend_note: Equal weighting across all 6 dimensions by default - flag if you want this weighted toward O/E ('the FDE spine') instead.

skill_indices.name: End-to-End Coherence
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Capstone submission shows Discovery -> Architecture -> Implementation -> Demo as one coherent, traceable thread, not disconnected artefacts.

skill_indices.name: Demo Readiness
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: The working demo runs (live or recorded) without major failure and clearly maps back to the original business problem.

skill_indices.name: Independent Ownership
skill_indices.observable_behaviour: Evidence shows the candidate drove the capstone with minimal mentor intervention, reflecting deployment-readiness.
